Beyond Amazon's early autumn Prime Day deals and AirPods Pro 3 discounted by $50, the Apple Watch Ultra 3 clearance discount is back, nearly $200 off the original price. Today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also includes the Apple 24GB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air at $150 off, Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini with launch deals returning, and the Apple Magic Keyboard at nearly 20% off. On top of those deals, there are Beats woven USB-C short cables under $8, plus a series of fresh exclusive discounts on iPhone 18 Pro cases. See below for details.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (originally $249)

Back in stock: Apple Watch Ultra 3 Milanese Loop clearance hits all-time low, nearly $200 off

The Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 are officially here, and we are still catching a number of early launch deals on various models over at Amazon. You'll find those below, while clearance deals on the two most popular Apple Watch Ultra models have also been restocked at Amazon, nearly $200 off their original prices.

Amazon is now offering both the Black Titanium and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models with the Milanese Loop, priced as low as $699.97 with free shipping.

$199 off the original $899 price tag and the equivalent Ultra 4 model pricing.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $700 (originally $899)

We mentioned both of these deals yesterday, but they started going in and out of stock pretty quickly, and now appear to be back. Following new model releases, these all-time low Apple Watch clearance prices tend to offer the best wearable value for those not chasing the very latest and greatest, and the Ultra 3 is still a more than capable choice that looks nearly identical to the new one.

Series 12 and Ultra 4 launch discounts are also live:

Apple Watch Series 12

  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 42mm: $390 (originally $399)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS 46mm: $440 (originally $449)
  • Apple Watch Series 12 GPS + Cellular 46mm: $540 (originally $549)

Apple Watch Ultra 4

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 GPS + Cellular 49mm: $780 (originally $799)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4 49mm GPS + Cellular: $780 (originally $799)

Apple 24GB 13-inch M5 MacBook Air down $150 at Amazon, up to $300 off on refurbished units

Although we're still tracking up to $300 off on the 15-inch models through Apple's official refurbished store, Amazon is now offering several 13-inch 24GB M5 MacBook Air models at $150 off their original prices.

Apple's official refurbished store has been a great place to grab M5 MacBook Air deals, particularly over the past 3 months or so. However, stock is very limited, and the discounts currently only apply to the 15-inch models.

Amazon is now offering $150 off new 14-inch models though, including the mid-tier 1TB model and the upgraded variant with 24GB RAM:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (originally $1,799)

As for the Apple refurbished deals, color options have been getting more limited since we last reported, but you can still save up to $300 on select models:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,269 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new)
  • Midnight, Sky Blue

Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini launch discount returns

Beyond the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 deals and Apple Watch Series 12 early launch discounts, Amazon has also brought back launch discounts on Apple's new 24GB M6 Mac mini.

Amazon is once again offering the new M6 Mac mini with 24GB RAM and 512GB storage, priced as low as $1,269.99 with free shipping.

It's admittedly not a massive discount compared to the $1,299 MSRP, but the price on this brand-new unit is back down to the lowest we've tracked, making it a solid saving opportunity for those looking to get in early. Early launch discounts on the new M6 Mac mini have been a bit unstable since launch, with prices bouncing between MSRP and the discounted rate, but at the time of writing, two models are once again available at the discounted price.

Beyond the 24GB model deals, there's also a discount on the mid-tier 16GB model — we'll keep an eye on the entry-level and M5 Pro models:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)

Most affordable USB-C Apple Magic Keyboard at nearly 20% off, today's only deal

Add Hyper's latest Thunderbolt 5 Dock to your new Mac setup, down $80 (Amazon low)

One of Hyper's newest MacBook and Mac mini/Studio accessories, the HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure, has dropped to the lowest price we've tracked at Amazon, down $80.

The brand's official Amazon storefront is once again offering its latest HyperDrive Next Thunderbolt 5 Dock with SSD enclosure, priced as low as $319.99 with free shipping.

Down from $400, this discount is similar to the one we mentioned last time and matches the best $80 discount we've tracked at Amazon since it launched earlier this year.

New Beats 360 ANC headphones launch deal: Modular Cushion Kit for $10, save 80%

As we mentioned yesterday in the larger Beats roundup, Apple's sub-brand has now officially launched the all-new Beats 360 over-ear headphones with swappable ear cushions and headbands. Now available for pre-order, we're also seeing launch deals on the Beats 360 — the Beats 360 Cushion Kit is on sale at a limited-time price of $9.99.

The new Beats 360 headphones feature a modular design that lets users swap out and replace the ear cushions and headband pads. The headphones themselves ship with one color-matched Cushion Kit, and you can now grab seven different color Beats 360 Cushion Kits at a discount, making it easy to style them to your taste, or swap in a fresh Cushion Kit after a workout.

  • Beats 360 over-ear headphones $350
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (originally $50)

Early autumn Prime Day Ring deals from $40: latest 4K models hit new low with $100 off, more

Early autumn Prime Day deals have officially landed on the Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro and battery-powered wireless model, both of which have dropped to brand new Amazon all-time lows at 40% off. Read on for details and the rest of the Ring lineup starting from $40 in these early Prime Big Deal Days offers.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $150 (originally $250)

Both are Ring's newest 4K video smart doorbells, originally priced at $250. Now $100 off, or 40% of the price, setting new Amazon all-time lows — these models never dipped below $180 prior to today's early autumn Prime deals.

Although Amazon kicked off the early autumn Prime Day deals early this year, well ahead of the October 6 launch date, they clearly keep adding new offers to the early event, and plenty of them are extremely compelling options.

Functionally, both options are essentially the same, with the only difference being whether you go wired or completely wireless on the battery-powered setup — the wireless model comes with a Quick Release Ultra Battery Pack for easy charging and a much simpler install (no wiring required); the wired model delivers 'non-stop power, all-day protection.' Beyond that, both pack 10x enhanced zoom, night vision, and wide-angle Retinal 4K video.
